The same four driver files are committed in the upstream tree under
releases/1.1.1.0/ at the tag, byte-identical (SHA-256 compared 2026-09-29).
Not used by USOS: debug-x86/, debug-x64/, xhciqual/ and xhcisnap/ (the DOS
and Win32 tools carry third-party runtimes, see their NOTICE.TXT).

Corresponding source (GPLv2 section 3): the GitHub tarball of the tag,
  https://github.com/yeokm1/xhci98/archive/refs/tags/v1.1.1.0.tar.gz
  kept locally as tools/vendor/xhci98/1.1.1.0-src/
  xhci98-7d0dd9d440e9716a87e0882f905bf8e99fa443ac.tar.gz (git-ignored, 9 MB)
  SHA-256 4f2653d00ee757c5edefcda6f7101526edf5b0778a07ebf5babbb59805088af3
  (GitHub tarballs are not guaranteed stable byte for byte; the commit id
  is the authoritative pin). A release that ships xhci98.sys must ship this
  source archive next to it or carry a written offer.

USOS changes when staging (tools/nt52_usb_stage.sh): the INF's
[SourceDisksNames] row 1 becomes 1=%DiskName%,,,\<i386|amd64>\xhci98 (no
tag file), and a second xhci98.sys goes to that folder of the local source
(text-mode Setup moves the first one), so GUI-mode Setup finds it. Nothing
else in the INF and nothing in the .sys is changed.
